description: Road Maintenance Jurisdiction & Function Class is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. The GIS-Mo Road Maintenance Jurisdiction & Function Class data is used in for several CountyView Data Menu items based on different fields. The menu items based on this data are: Arterials - Co. Ord. 2015-23 (Local Function Class), Arterials - FHWA - 2013 (Federal Function Class), Roads - Maintenance Jurisdiction (Jurisdiction). Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are mobility, roads, crab, pierce county roads, gismo. The table has 27 columns. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
